title: KeyError race in AiocoapResourceTransport backoff cleanup
description:
In ip_coap.py, both request() (line 178) and observe() (line 251) delete expired backoff entries using 'del self._peer_backoffs[peer]'. Under concurrent requests to the same peer after backoff expires, multiple coroutines can read the same expired entry via .get(), both determine remaining <= 0, and both attempt deletion. The second delete raises KeyError.

Fix: Replace 'del self._peer_backoffs[peer]' with 'self._peer_backoffs.pop(peer, None)' at both locations.

File: src/lichen/client/ip_coap.py
Lines: 178, 251
